voiceover.script: I spent sixty bucks on these for work, and honestly? I regret not buying them sooner. I do twelve-hour shifts on concrete floors, and my feet used to be done by hour eight. These have a wide toe box, real arch support, and they're slip-resistant. No more limping to my car after a twelve. And three other nurses on my floor ordered them after seeing mine.
